newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.028pts to 100.554.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.028pts to 100.554.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.028 points in Friday's trading to 100.554 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.546 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.030 points to 96.759, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.322 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.254 points to 1,151.014.
